title: Backoff test comment says '60s' for first failure, should be '30s'
description: In kith-store/src/outbox.rs the test comment for the first failure case claims the expected delay is '60s' but the formula is 30 * 2^0 = 30s. The test itself correctly asserts [24, 36]s (30 ± 20%). The comment is misleading — a maintainer adjusting the base delay would read the comment and conclude their change is correct when it isn't. — Fix the comment to state 'base = 30s, ±20% jitter → [24, 36]'.
